item: fix the TheAnswerBoss 'char' TypeError class in roblox/src

Fix comment in file carries the receipt. After: TheAnswerBoss contributes only documented noise classes (Unknown require, 'number?' GetAttribute) and a pre-existing DeprecatedApi BreakJoints that the gate grep does not match; 'char' TypeError and both LocalShadow warnings gone, LocalUnused root at 102 gone. Negatives: no other 'char' reference exists in the module; mountain_check findings on first run are all in files this lane did not touch, so no rerun was needed.
